cohort: The study included pregnant participants categorized into four groups based on pregestational obesity and weight gain during pregnancy.
finding: Pregestational obesity was linked to higher odds of gestational diabetes, while excessive weight gain was linked to higher odds of pregnancy-induced hypertension; both conditions were associated with increased chances of large for gestational age newborns.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was not significantly affected by pregestational obesity or excessive weight gain.
birth_weight: Not specified as a general range; however, Large for Gestational Age (LGA) newborns were an evaluated outcome.
gest_age: Not specified as a general range; however, Large for Gestational Age (LGA) newborns were an evaluated outcome, indicating gestational age was assessed.
